summary: Loads a custom C++ DAT plugin that can output either table or text data and expose plugin-defined custom parameters.

key_params.name: reinit
key_params.note: Delete and recreate the plugin class instance when enabled

key_params.name: reinitpulse
key_params.note: Immediately reinitialize the plugin class instance

key_params.name: unloadplugin
key_params.note: Unload the plugin after all DATs using it have released it

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language setting for node text context

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Choose the edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom extension used when Extension is set to Custom Extension

common_gotchas: Plugin binaries are platform/build dependent and must be compiled against the appropriate TouchDesigner C++ headers.
Multiple CPlusPlus DATs using the same plugin may all need to unload before the file can be replaced.
Cell names and assigned text names must be valid UTF-8 regardless of whether the DAT is table or text output.
Custom parameters are created by plugin code in setupParameters(), so generated plans cannot assume a stable parameter surface without inspecting the plugin.
key_concepts: Loads a C++ DAT plugin and outputs table or text generated by the plugin.
The plugin can define custom parameters beyond the base CPlusPlus DAT controls.
Reinit unloads and recreates the plugin instance to pick up changed plugin code.
Unload Plugin releases the plugin binary after all operators using it are unloaded.
platform_notes: Plugin binary naming and build output are platform-specific; the CPlusPlus DAT page links to the official C++ plugin authoring guide.
